moveto-all-routes-blocked-walks-into-cre.actual: The Rust engine mirrors stable vanilla: `Creep.moveTo` runs `pos.findPathTo` (`_findPath2` semantics) and moves on whatever path comes back, with no destination-occupancy check. PathFinder returns a PARTIAL path when the goal range is unreachable — the origin is not a fallback candidate — so the creep steps one tile toward the goal and moveTo returns OK (screeps/engine#63).
moveto-all-routes-blocked-walks-into-cre.expected: creep.moveTo with ignoreCreeps:false returns ERR_NO_PATH when every viable route is blocked by a stationary creep.

roomposition-find-closest-by-path-range-.actual: The Rust engine mirrors stable vanilla's `_findClosestByPath2`: it never reads `opts.range`, hardcoding `{range: 1, pos: i}` on every PathFinder goal and post-filtering reachability with `lastPos.isNearTo(obj)`.
roomposition-find-closest-by-path-range-.expected: RoomPosition.findClosestByPath uses opts.range as the goal range when deciding reachability.
